text: Planning a trip is exciting, but it also takes time and effort. Last summer, I travelled to Japan with two friends. Before we left, we booked our flights and hotels and made a long list of places to visit. When we arrived, everything felt new and different: the streets, the customs, and the food. We tried sushi, ramen, and many dishes we had never seen before. Sometimes we faced language barriers, but people were kind and helped us with gestures and smiles. Those small, funny moments became some of my best memories. Travelling teaches you so much about the world, and about yourself too.
